svg.aria-label: How does it all fit together?

g.text: How does it all fit together?
the order: box types, sizes, counts
every legal next move is a candidate: any box, flush to an edge or a face
centre of mass past the edge
each candidate must pass both; the rest are discarded
each candidate is completed greedily and the full plan is scored
rank by score (stackable, volume, top area), keep the top few
